name: Redis Snapshot (BGSAVE)
description: Ask a Redis server to write an RDB snapshot to its own disk in the background on a schedule with redis-cli. This triggers the snapshot on the server; it does not copy the file anywhere else.

parameters.label: Redis host
parameters.help: The hostname or address of the Redis server. The redis-cli tool must be installed and on the PATH.

parameters.label: Redis port
parameters.help: The port the Redis server listens on. This command sends no password, so the server must allow unauthenticated access from this machine.
